name: CUPHD Outreach v.1.02
author: bagraves
description: Take on the role of a B Cell guarding a mucosal gland from respiratory pathogens. Based on real conditions, the player is tasked with using antibodies to eliminate SARS-CoV-2 pathogens, variants, and, later in the year, Influenza pathogens (who require flu-specific antibodies to defeat).            v1.02 changelog: added menu music, sfx to the changing months, reconfigured music/sfx volume toggles to work, made the victory wave destroy remaining pathogens to prevent dual victory/defeat.
